purpose: Bounded CI production-integration development retrieval; separate from the frozen historical development set and held-outs.

questions.query: How does production Native CI use six parallel families without weakening scientific coverage or the TSan deadline?
facts: The six families preserve all original commands, fixtures, assertions, scoped environments and original per-command limits, including the15-minute TSan suite.
The stable native aggregate requires complete source/run/attempt-bound successful original evidence; missing or failed shards cannot pass.
The five expanded experimental311 bounds are not production policy; historical exit124 remains retained.

questions.query: Does four-way Windows Godot sharding change test coverage or replace Linux graphical qualification?
facts: Four Windows shards execute every current applicable headless case exactly once and retain separate imports and original logs.
The independent coverage reducer runs after admitted failed/cancelled matrices and requires source/runtime/log completeness and upstream success.
All Linux graphical/build/sharded gates and per-case deadlines remain; old201-case timing does not qualify a later208-case head.

questions.query: Can the Native source-scope advisory authorize skipping required tests for presentation-only changes?
facts: No: native_skip_authorized=false remains unconditional and no Native/Godot required job consumes an exemption.
The report authenticates immutable base/executed-head commits and classifier bytes, uses NUL-delimited no-renames Git diff, and conservatively handles invalid/unknown paths.
An actual skip policy needs a separate owner decision and dependency audit; the advisory claims no runtime saving.
